description: Static acceptance scenarios and prompt anchors, not execution of an LLM or native Kent effects.

cases.input: Task A needs deep diagnosis; Task B has a factual Question; Task C is healthy.
cases.expected: Scan A/B/C, answer B from authoritative evidence, bound A's diagnosis and continue the group cycle.
guards: Re-read all selected Tasks before deep diagnosis
one bounded diagnosis/action slice
a focused follow-up never replaces the whole-selection scan

cases.input: Task A is temporarily unreadable while B and C can be inspected.
cases.expected: Keep A explicitly unknown in the selection; process B/C without treating A as removed or complete.
guards: A failed read remains an explicit unknown
never silently drop that Task

cases.input: In overnight mode A already has a mandatory human Approval; B needs permitted factual help.
cases.expected: Retain A's Approval, notify once, help B and continue observation without a duplicate supervisor Question.
guards: Do not duplicate an existing Question or Approval
In autonomous/overnight operation
continue observing the rest

cases.input: A pending permission Question repeats an exact applicable original human decision.
cases.expected: Verify original provenance and current target, relay the decision as an agent and read back resolution; do not ask for the same consent.
guards: Do not demand the same decision
Immediately before `kent question answer`
Read back the Question/execution outcome

cases.input: The caller delegated routine operational choices; two safe diagnostic orders satisfy the same authorized procedure.
cases.expected: Choose and cite the operational mandate without a human Question or routine Grill call.
guards: Choose routine diagnostic order
explicit operational delegation covers that choice
not a human answer

cases.input: Routine decisions were delegated, but a previously unaccepted governance plan needs independent human judgment.
cases.expected: Preserve its actual owning approval; delegation does not accept the new plan or waive governance.
guards: cannot accept an unknown plan/result
Mandatory governance reviews and independent human judgments
not permission to decide for the user

cases.input: The caller selected a project backlog and authorized four starts; five candidates exist.
cases.expected: Resolve stable selection and dependencies within the four-start mandate, not unlimited project execution.
guards: within the caller's criteria and start limit
it is not unlimited execution authority
no retained/live execution or competing start/recovery

cases.input: A material unresolved operational choice has evidence and alternatives; child depth permits a critic.
cases.expected: Start one bounded read-only Grill with evidence/authority/options, continue the group scan and retain responsibility.
guards: kent run --agent grill
one bounded read-only
Keep inspecting the whole Task selection
does not replace mandatory independent governance reviews

cases.input: The headless supervisor is already at the configured child-depth limit.
cases.expected: Keep the precise critique gap or use permitted owner communication; no depth/config change or operational fallback.
guards: At a prohibited child depth or in Workflow
Do not create other children
substitute an operational role when Grill is unavailable

cases.input: The human identifies an auxiliary fix-worker Session, but its locked role prohibits the requested merge.
cases.expected: Verify the role before routing; use the supervisor's own qualified merge permission if applicable, not a known-incapable recipient.
guards: Verify a proposed operator's actual role
Do not recommend a known-incapable owner
Do not ask the human to open an operator Session

cases.input: The accepted selected PR, repository, base/head, permitted rebase method, current checks and original merge authority match.
cases.expected: Record intent, perform a head-bound provider merge and verify provider evidence; no repeat consent or branch deletion.
guards: accepted PR result
--match-head-commit
explicit repository/PR
Record intent and read back provider state

cases.input: The PR head changes between preflight and effect.
cases.expected: The head guard prevents stale merge; recheck accepted content and authority before any subsequent request.
guards: bind the request to the verified head
Changed or unaccepted PR content requires renewed authority/result checks

cases.input: Only project A has permission not to await CI; project B's checks are pending.
cases.expected: Do not transfer the waiver to B or bypass provider protections.
guards: A project-specific CI waiver does not transfer
Do not use `--admin`

cases.input: The provider accepts a request into a merge queue or enables auto-merge.
cases.expected: Report queued, continue group observation and do not claim merge, Done or installation.
guards: Queued or auto-merge-enabled is not merged
Verified merge does not prove Task cleanup or installed adoption

cases.input: An interrupted selected other Task has a diagnosed input failure and a project-qualified native route with preserved inputs, context, ownership and gates.
cases.expected: Use the exact existing route within the shared incident budget, then verify real ownership/execution.
guards: Before `kent task move`
provenance of every required input
verify native ownership and actual execution
one automatic recovery-effect budget

cases.input: A graph edge exists and CLI help accepts move, but preservation of approval/context semantics has not been qualified.
cases.expected: Keep a concrete capability gap; do not move or invent success evidence.
guards: A supported edge alone does not qualify a route
Unknown semantics remain a capability gap
Do not supply fabricated success values

cases.input: The human deliberately stopped A; an older general observation mandate remains.
cases.expected: Do not automatically recover A; a fresh exact post-stop instruction is required.
guards: Never automatically resume a deliberate human stop
A fresh explicit instruction to resume an exact deliberately stopped Task

cases.input: A Resume or native recovery response is lost; its effect may already have occurred.
cases.expected: Reconcile native state before any replay; preserve the unsettled incident budget after compaction.
guards: one effective or unsettled attempt
Do not enumerate transitions or retry an unknown effect
preserve budgets across compaction/restart

cases.input: A same-node recovery was proved to have no effect; another project-qualified equivalent route satisfies the same authority and preconditions.
cases.expected: Diagnose the no-op, verify equivalence and enact at most the remaining permitted effect without asking for the same consent.
guards: A proved no-op does not consume an effect
all its preconditions are proved
Do not enumerate transitions

cases.input: One fan-out branch failed and a tempting target would omit its siblings and Join.
cases.expected: Do not independently start the sibling or bypass Join; use only a qualified group-preserving recovery.
guards: preservation of approval/review and fan-out/Join invariants
launch one fan-out sibling independently

cases.input: All selected Tasks are Done and PRs merged, but the requested installed adoption is unproved.
cases.expected: Report the unmet outcome and missing authorized adoption evidence; no success claim or implicit installation/restart.
guards: do not declare success from Done or merge alone
Installation/configuration/restart still need separately approved effects

cases.input: After compaction, A has an unfinished intent, B progressed and C has an existing human gate.
cases.expected: Restore the entire selection/authority/budgets, reconcile A, process B and retain C's gate before any new Question.
guards: After an answer, restart or compaction
Reconcile unknown effects before any retry
must not reset incident retry budgets
before another human Question
